question:
In the given figure, AB || CD || EF, ∠APO = 35° and ∠CQO = 43°. The value of ∠EOP + ∠EOQ is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fad895fff511dd370045462be889172333fa1dc61a1f76ae07b8fb69d2743317.png]
solution:
Given:

AB || CD || EF 

∠APO = 35°

∠CQO = 43°

Calculation:

According to the question

We know alternate angle equal to each other 

So, ∠APO = ∠POF = 35° 

⇒ ∠EOP = 180° - ∠POF (Linear pair)

⇒ ∠EOP = 180° - 35° 

⇒ ∠EOP = 145°

Similarly,

∠CQO = ∠FOQ are alternate angle

⇒ ∠FOQ = 43° 

⇒ ∠EOQ = 180° - ∠FOQ (Linear pair)

⇒ ∠EOQ = 180° - 43° 

⇒ ∠EOQ = 137°

So, ∠EOP + ∠EOQ = 145° + 137° 

⇒ ∠EOP + ∠EOQ = 282° 

∴ The value of **∠EOP + ∠EOQ is 282° **
